findings.title_en: Worker without a hard hat below the roof edge
Carrying a roll while using the ladder
Worker on roof edge with no visible fall protection

summary_en: A total of 3 findings: 2 high severity and 1 low with an uncertain determination. The most urgent item is using the ladder while carrying a roll without a hard hat below the roof edge. Roof and ladder work in this area should stop until the high findings are corrected and roof fall protection is verified.
